title: WASD FX
cue: effects by name: explosion, fire, smoke, hit flash, dissolve
summary: Eighteen effects in one line each: explosions, sparks, impacts, muzzle flashes, magic, pickups, fire, smoke, steam, embers. Also a hit flash, an outline, and a dissolve on any thing. No setup.
useWhen: Something in a 3D game hits, breaks, burns, fires, lands, is picked up, or casts a spell and should show it: WasdFx.play("explosion", position) from any script. Also fires and smoke that keep running, a flash on what is hit, an outline round what is selected, and a thing that dissolves away.
avoidWhen: A 2D game, or an effect that must follow a path, such as a sword's trail, which trail-renderer draws. Beams, halos, fog, and a flame's glow and flicker are wasd-light's; a mark left behind, such as a scorch or a bullet hole, is wasd-decals'.
